verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says users can 'extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows,' a first-party claim of webhook support. The evidence is only a single marketing line, with no documentation of registering callbacks or of event types, so the depth is unproven. The Slack, Discord and Teams sync claim is chat-app integration and does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration (UI/API), list of subscribable events, payload format and signing/secret verification, delivery and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
